title: Text: Miech ↔ Anthony Fenech
snippet: Know the waiting must be tuff. I heard today that Harper's wife Kayla is begging for him to be a Dodger; she hates the East coast (Philly). Boras has discovered, tho, that lack of leverage is a bitch.
